title: Search extracted files locally
changes: Add case-sensitive UTF-8 search over bounded file blocks, highlight matches, support repeated and overlapping results, cancellation and restart.
validation: Real-time Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-search-realtime-gbmtuu6n checked a UTF-8 match across a 256 KiB boundary, highlighting, repeated and overlapping matches, cancellation, file replacement and empty input.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-search-eur-q9gr1swj searched an actual extracted file beyond 8 MiB using the browser File API and checked the highlight and restart.
limitations: Search is literal and case-sensitive; the text field is limited to 1024 characters. Earlier prototype t2dkxkfs remained incomplete; realtime unit h0_k4768 passed browser assertions but failed retention because Chrome singleton links remained, and the corrected harness closed Chrome cleanly.
